# Brand Collection

> Brand Collection is an online clothing store in Pakistan selling men's, women's and kids' streetwear, techwear, hoodies, jackets and pret. Prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Cash on Delivery is available nationwide.

## Key facts
- Delivery: all over Pakistan by TCS, Call Courier and Trax. Lahore 1–2 days, Karachi/Islamabad/Rawalpindi 2–3 days, other cities 3–5 days.
- Shipping fee: Rs 250; free on orders over Rs 5,000. Cash on Delivery fee: Rs 150.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, JazzCash, Easypaisa.
- Returns: 7-day easy exchange. See the returns policy.
- Customer support (WhatsApp): +966543805017. Email: mabbasansaari77@gmail.com.

## What people search for (and what we sell)
- Online clothing store in Pakistan with Cash on Delivery
- Hoodies for men in Pakistan, oversized hoodies, kids hoodies
- Cargo pants and baggy cargo pants in Pakistan
- Winter jackets in Pakistan
- Graphic tees and oversized tees in Pakistan
- Women's pret, kurtis and ladies online clothing in Pakistan
- Kids clothes online in Pakistan
- Streetwear in Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and nationwide delivery)
